description: This file defines the TransactionCommitter class, which manages transaction commit operations within the Orleans framework, including handling commit logic, participating in lifecycle events, and managing transaction state.

classes.name: TransactionCommitter<TService>
classes.description: A class responsible for managing transaction commits, including handling commit operations, participating in lifecycle events, and managing transaction state within Orleans.

methods.name: OnCommit
methods.description: Handles the commit operation for a transaction, including locking, state copying, and logging.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the committer to lifecycle events for setup.

methods.name: OnSetupState
methods.description: Initializes transaction state, including creating storage, setting up the transaction queue, and recovering state.
